dedupe_keys.name: metropt predictive maintenance compressed air train sensors

description: The MetroPT project releases an operating metro train's air-production-unit sensor record from Porto, Portugal. The public Zenodo benchmark is CC BY 4.0 and consists of one data file. Coverage is one Porto metro train from January to June 2022, with one-hertz acquisition and about 10.98 million data points and 20 variables that include analogue and digital sensors plus GPS. These measurements can test predictive-maintenance or condition-dependent transit-service simulations. A caveat is that the labelled faults and operating cycle belong to one APU in one network; a model transferred to other rolling stock needs fresh calibration. The article states the released table was not imputed, but this does not prove every sensor value is physically correct. I read the own Zenodo metadata and article Data Records without downloading the CSV, plotting signals or reproducing a fault classifier. No directly related catalogue record was identified.
